cleavage agent: The biotinylated-ubiquitinated proteins immobilized on beads were reduced, alkylated, trypsinized
enrichment method: digested with trypsin for subsequent enrichment of diGly peptides with diGly antibody-conjugated beads
instrument: analyzed and quantitated by nanoelectrospray LC–MS/MS on an LTQ Orbitrap Velos (Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc.)
ionization type: analyzed and quantitated by nanoelectrospray LC–MS/MS on an LTQ Orbitrap Velos (Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc.)
labeling: The purified peptides were analyzed and quantitated by nanoelectrospray LC–MS/MS on an LTQ Orbitrap Velos (Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc.)
ptm: purified by Ubiquitin Branch Motif (K-ϵ-GG) affinity purification procedure
